image_description: A full-body shot of a Cavalier King Charles Spaniel (Blenheim variety) standing in profile on a green grass lawn. The dog has a white coat with rich chestnut/red patches, long feathered ears, and a docked tail carried level with the back.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is domed with short upturned nose and well-defined stop.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head shape exhibits the characteristic dome and the muzzle appears short with a distinct stop, consistent with the breed standard.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are large, round, dark, and set wide apart.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Eyes appear dark, round, and widely spaced, contributing to the gentle expression typical of the breed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ears are long, set low, and heavily feathered with long fringe.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Ears are clearly visible, set low on the skull, and display significant length and heavy feathering/fringe.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rich red-and-white parti-color coat with clearly defined red patches on white ground.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coat pattern matches the Blenheim description perfectly: white base with distinct chestnut/red patches on the head and body.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Coat is long, silky, and straight with moderate feathering on ears, chest, legs, and tail.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Texture appears silky and straight; feathering is visible on the ears, chest, and hind legs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is compact and cobby with short back of small toy-spaniel proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dog's proportions are compact with a relatively short back, fitting the 'cobby' toy spaniel description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Legs are straight with fine bone and feathered hindquarters.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Front legs appear straight and fine-boned; hindquarters show the expected feathering.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is docked and carried level with back, well-feathered.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is visible, appears docked (not reaching the hock), is held level with the topline, and has feathering.
